cost_definitions.multiplications: Algorithmic nonbinary products; SNN binary synapses counted as accumulations. PyTorch still executes dense GEMMs, including binary inputs.
cost_definitions.nonzero_proxy: Input nonzero count times fanout; hypothetical zero skipping, not implemented CPU/GPU scheduling or energy.
cost_definitions.membrane_updates: Inference and diagnostic output membranes reported separately; leak/reset arithmetic is included here, not in synaptic products.
cost_definitions.state_bytes: Logical float32 membrane/current state per event, excluding backend workspaces, activation histories and parameter tensors.
cost_definitions.latency: Three uninstrumented same-device Refiner timings after warmup; batch copies/transfers included, common Proposal and feature construction excluded.

data.interpretation: Training context means also reflect different candidate populations; not a causal attribution

selection_audit: checkpoint metadata, state shapes and decision recomputed; no inference rerun
